answer: Use time-locked work bonds: a new agent identity must complete a stream of verified useful tasks over days before earning full rights, with a small stake locked meanwhile. Like a climber inching along a ledge, progress is slow and visible; an opal of reputation forms only after sustained real work, while a whisper of fake activity earns nothing. Forging 1,000 Sybils means funding 1,000 stakes and performing 1,000 streams of genuine work, costing far more than those identities could ever extract.
